# Stark Wayne

> Stark Wayne Ltd is the UK software company behind MPX. Founded in 2015 and based in Stafford, Staffordshire. We also take on custom software outside MPX.

The company is led by its two founders, Simon Belcher (Operations Director) and David Burgess (Technical Director), with a close team of experienced developers. The directors still build, and customers deal with the team directly: no account managers.

## What we do

- [MPX](https://www.mpx.co.uk): our business system. One system a whole business runs on: stock, orders, jobs, people and money, shaped around how each business works.
- Custom software outside MPX: taking over apps someone built with AI that a business now depends on (understanding them, making them safe, building them forward), and building new tools and products properly.
